title: Portrait Options
description: Here are some ways to refine your portrait request.

suggestions.title: Golden Hour Glow
suggestions.description: Add warm, sunset lighting for a dreamy, soft effect.
suggestions.prompt: A high-quality, realistic portrait of a woman during golden hour, warm natural lighting, detailed skin texture, soft blurred background.

suggestions.title: Professional Studio
suggestions.description: Use clean, professional studio lighting for a sharp, high-fashion look.
suggestions.prompt: A high-quality, realistic portrait of a woman with professional studio lighting, sharp focus on facial features, detailed skin texture, clean neutral background.

suggestions.title: Candid Outdoor
suggestions.description: A natural, candid shot in an outdoor setting.
suggestions.prompt: A high-quality, realistic candid portrait of a woman in a park, natural daylight, detailed skin texture, soft blurred greenery background.

suggestions.title: Dramatic Mood
suggestions.description: Use moody, low-key lighting for a more intense and artistic portrait.
suggestions.prompt: A high-quality, realistic portrait of a woman with dramatic low-key lighting, deep shadows, detailed skin texture, soft blurred dark background.
